items.title: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Lautoka, Viti Levu to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Remote beaches and rich Polynesian culture abound throughout this iconic South Pacific voyage to Fiji, Tonga, the Cook Islands, and French Polynesia, where you’ll experience the pristine beauty of turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. On Rarotonga, join a guided nature trek, where you’ll learn about the island’s culture and history from a local. Explore the subterranean splendors of 'Ana Hulu in Tonga, a coral limestone cavern concealing centuries-old freshwater lakes, or wander scenic rainforest paths in Taveuni's Bouma National Heritage Park. Indulge in sweet cocoa farm treats during a delicious tree-to-bar tour on Vana Levu, or dine on Fijian fish dishes and tropical fruit cocktails. Rekindle romantic magic at beachside resort accommodations during an overnight stay on Bora Bora, and allow flowers to perfume the air as you sail into a fiery sunset.

items.title: Italy and the Allure of the Aeolian Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenic vineyards, dizzying Amalfi coastal vistas, timeless village piazzas, and ancient Roman ruins make perfect backdrops for this cruise along Italy's coast to the isles of Corsica and Sardinia. Relax on a sandy beach outside Ponza or escape on a boat tour to the clear turquoise waters and sundrenched shorelines punctuated by shadowy coastal grottos. Sip the sweetness of local Amalfi limoncello and tour the haunting ruins of Pompeii. Cycle past geologic wonders on Lipari - the largest and most storied of the seven Aeolian isles - then pause at an Italian hamlet for liquid refreshments and light bites. Luxuriate along the Emerald Coast near Porto Cervo, Sardinia's luxurious enclave for reclusive yacht owners and Europe's most expensive real estate. Inspect the dramatic vistas of Bonifacio, Corsica's oldest settlement known for its cliffs, medieval citadel, and stunning coastal views.

items.title: Star Collector: Scottish and Viking Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Dun Laoghaire, Dublin on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor the sight of indigo fjords and colorful fjord towns, and delve into Celtic culture from Scottish tartans and historic Highland castles to lively Irish celidhs. Incredible scenery takes many forms: Rapunzel-like waterfalls, romantic ruins, crooked old warehouses, wild islands. And with a mix of popular ports and several small maiden ports, there’s always something new to discover. Explore Bergen’s UNESCO wharf and Alesund’s famous Art Deco architecture – two towns in a neck-and-neck race for the most picturesque fjord city. Discover neolithic ruins on remote Scottish isles, sip local tipples from Guinness to whisky, and trace legends to their source at the Giant’s Causeway and Loch Ness. This unique itinerary includes maiden calls to tiny fjord towns like Andalsnes, Froya, and OldenLoen, as well as Trondheim, Norway’s charming and walkable first capital.

items.title: Total Solar Eclipse from Greece and Malta
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Surf
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the awe of a total solar eclipse, lasting approximately 3 minutes, from a prime viewing position near Malta—the centerpiece of this extraordinary Mediterranean voyage. Along the way, you’ll uncover hidden gems and smaller ports, from Monemvasia, Greece’s “Gibraltar of the East,” to the Peloponnesian harbor of Gythion. Sail the shores of Sicily with visits to Syracuse and the vibrant western town of Trapani, then continue to Malta for golden Valletta and the quiet charm of Gozo. With convenient roundtrip embarkation and debarkation in Athens, this journey blends rare celestial wonder with authentic local escapes steeped in history and beauty.

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Coastlines of Croatia & Italy
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Beauty surrounds you on this voyage through Southern Italy and the Croatian Adriatic—colorful cliffside villages, enchanting canals, and turquoise waterfalls rushing through pine forests. Sip limoncello in Amalfi, admire Vibo Valentia’s Coast of the Gods, and stand in awe of Reggio Calabria’s ancient bronze warriors. Overnight in Taranto for famous mussels and views of the Aragonese Castle lit at night. In Rovinj, centuries of Venetian rule have blended cultures and flavors. Listen to Zadar’s sea organ echoing the rhythm of the waves, and fall in love with riviera towns and islands that capture your heart.

items.title: Star Collector: The “Sole” of Italy & Coast of Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Spend 20 nights exploring the Adriatic and Ionian Seas, soaking in Southern Italy’s charm and Croatia’s breathtaking coastline. Discover Amalfi’s stunning blend of nature and architecture, stroll seafront promenades in laid-back villages, and savor Calabria’s famous Tartufo di Pizzo. Overnight in Taranto, gateway to Baroque Lecce and Alberobello’s whimsical trulli huts. Then sail into Croatia’s magic—historic walled cities, Istrian fishing villages, and Venice’s timeless allure. In Rovinj, find Italian influences in every bite and building. Wander the medieval streets of Šibenik, discover Habsburg-era elegance in Opatija, and explore Roman and Venetian landmarks in charming Poreč. From off the beaten path Croatia to Kotor’s bay, every stop tells a different story.

items.title: Star Collector: Irish Stout to Bordeaux Wine: A Tour of Ireland and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Bordeaux on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Irish dancing, twinkling Parisian lights and sublime French wines enhance your tasteful cultural immersion throughout this sailing around Ireland and along the French coastline. Explore Ireland's Inishowen Peninsula, a natural encapsulation of Emerald Isle habitats, and wander sandy coastal reaches and cobbled village lanes prior to tea and local treats at a village beyond Londonderry. Take a stroll around St. Mary's quay to the formidable Star Castle, a 1593 fortification built to reinforce England. Spend two exceptional days in Paris visiting the Louvre Museum, Versailles and Notre-Dame during your extended port stay at Rouen. Venture inland from the coastal town of Lorient for Breton tea time with the Duchess of Rohan amid Josselin Castle's tasteful elegance. Unwind over exceptional glasses of blended red wines and fine French cuisine during an overnight Bordeaux port stay.

items.title: Iconic & Hidden Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the Croatian coast from tiny fishing villages to medieval marvels like Dubrovnik. This itinerary is ideal for those who enjoy exploring on foot, with an abundance of compact, pedestrian-only old towns and seafront promenades. Follow Roman street layouts past Venetian buildings, find quiet pebble beaches washed by the Adriatic’s turquoise waters, and head to national parks where waterfalls pour over travertine terraces. Check off UNESCO wonders like the history-laden streets of Dubrovnik and Split’s Diocletian’s Palace, savor Dalmatian prosciutto in Sibenik, and cross the Adriatic to Italy’s Puglia region. All this plus two of the most spectacular port approaches you’ll find, sailing directly through the Giudecca Canal to Venice, passing by St. Mark’s Square and the Doge’s Palace (a route exclusively for small ships like ours), and cruising the striking Bay of Kotor.

items.title: Quick Getaways: Croatia Calling
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on the perfect brief getaway or add an Adriatic exploration to your European vacation plans with this memorable four-day sailing from Venice to the most iconic and romantic ports in Croatia. Roll into the countryside beyond Rovinj on a cycling tour tracing the Parenzana Trail--a former Hapsburg Empire railroad line curving through rustic villages, dense forests, and weathered tunnels. Relax aboard a sailboat outbound from Zadar to the tiny island of Ugljan, where you'll swim, snorkel, sunbathe, and later savor local cheeses, savory meats and fresh local fruits. Admire garden views and the Hvar landscape during an authentic traditional brunch at an Old World family estate. Wander the cobblestone alleys of Dubrovnik's Old Town, or dip a kayak blade into the calm waters off scenic Lokrum Island as you follow your guide to caves and the crumbling remains of a nearly forgotten monastery.

items.title: Star Collector: Southern Italy & Northern Greece Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription:
Set sail for hidden havens and Western Civilization's ancient epicenters during this 19-night cruise to idyllic small ports and iconic destinations throughout Italy, Greece and Türkiye. Delve into Pompeii's silent ruins beneath brooding Mount Vesuvius. Cook up Maltese meals under the guidance of a skilled professional chef on the outskirts of historic Valetta. Glide in the glowing azure light of the famed Blue Grotto near Giardini Naxos. Visit the Sanctuary of Apollo--the sacred home of the Oracle Pythia and the epicenter of Greece's Golden Age. Walk in the footsteps of Europe's earliest merchant seafarers in Ephesus. Wander Skopelos' narrow village lanes as you ascend to the hilltop ruins of a Venetian castle overlooking this tiny port.

Transit through the Corinth Canal is subject to local conditions and may occasionally be impacted by closures due to natural causes or construction activity beyond Windstar’s control. Should a closure occur, the itinerary will be updated accordingly, and booked guests will be notified as soon as information becomes available.

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Frontiers & Japan’s Hidden Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the wilderness of Alaska, visiting ports like Ketchikan, known for its Native heritage, Juneau, gateway to Mendenhall Glacier, and Sitka, where Russian and Tlingit history meet. Cruising highlights include Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, where you can venture on Signature Expeditions with Zodiacs launching directly from Star Seeker. Embark on a transpacific crossing that offers 11 unhurried sea days. Your arrival in Japan brings you first to Sapporo, where Hokkaido’s rugged landscapes create a dynamic introduction. From there, the voyage transforms into a mystery cruise, where ports are revealed 36 hours before arrival—reminding you that it’s not only about where you’re going, but who you’re sailing with; let Windstar be your trusted guide as you uncover new-to-Windstar ports and small-ship exclusives before concluding in Osaka, gateway to Kyoto’s timeless temples.

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Tokyo on Star Seeker
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the rugged wilds of Alaska, sailing to Ketchikan, Juneau, and Sitka, before venturing across the Pacific on a stretch of 11 sea days, the perfect opportunity. Your arrival in Japan marks the beginning of the mystery cruise segment, where ports are revealed just 36 hours in advance, adding a thrilling element of surprise. But it’s not only about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with, and with Windstar as your trusted guide, every mystery becomes part of a shared adventure. After your mystery cruise segment, discover both hidden gems and iconic destinations such as Osaka, Hiroshima, and Tokyo. Small-ship access allows for immersive exploration of tucked-away harbors like Tomonoura, while still delivering the grandeur of major cities like Osaka and Tokyo.

items.title: French Feast: Normandy, Brittany & Aquitaine
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Bordeaux on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: This comprehensive exploration of France includes an overnight in Rouen (Paris), and visits the Normandy, Brittany, and Aquitaine regions of France. Treat your palate to fine wines in Bordeaux and cider in Brittany. Taste regional specialties like Cancale oysters and Breton galettes. And feast your eyes on timeless scenery: the abbey on Mont St. Michel, St. Malo’s pink sandstone cliffs, Monet’s garden in Giverny where water lilies still have the power to inspire. See iconic sights like the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame. And write your own adventures as you hike the unspoiled wild Breton coast.

items.title: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Barcelona on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover a wealth of treasures on a remarkable voyage from Paris, France to Barcelona, Spain, enriched by multiple overnight port stays. Your journey begins with an overnight stay in Rouen, offering time to explore Paris's iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the charming Montmartre district. From there, sail down the western coast of France, where four days among Bordeaux's vineyards await, providing a perfect opportunity for exploration and wine tasting. In St. Malo, walk along the medieval fortifications, delving into the city's storied maritime past. As the cruise continues through the Iberian Peninsula, experience Bilbao, renowned for its contemporary art and architecture. In Seville, marvel at the grandeur of the Alcázar and soak in the vibrant-historic city. The adventure extends to Tangier, where the exotic charm of Moroccan souks and promise a truly immersive experience.

items.title: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Lisbon on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Impressionist artists like Monet and Renoir spent a lifetime trying to capture the beauty and soul of western France. It took Julia Child just one meal in Normandy to fall in love with French cuisine. Be won over on this sensory journey to Northern Spain and France. Follow the Comino to the cathedral at Santiago de Compostela, a pilgrimage site for a thousand years. Sip cider in Gijon at the heart of “Green Spain,” a place even many Spaniards are unfamiliar with. Treat your palate to Basque cuisine. You’ll see hills covered in vineyards and chateaux in Bordeaux, Monet’s famous water lilies in Giverny, Mont St. Michel abbey perched on a tiny island like a wedding cake ornament, and as many Parisian wonders as you can absorb with a two-night stay in Rouen. Delicious. Moving. Awe-inspiring. This voyage is all that and more.

items.title: Star Collector: North Atlantic Explorer
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Boston, Ma on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Behold the youngest place on earth as you sail past Surtsey Island, created by an eruption in 1963. Overnight in Seydisfjordur, taking in cascading waterfalls and colorful historic houses imported from Norway. In Akureyri, visit Listagil, ride an Icelandic horse and soak in the sky-blue Myvatn Nature Baths. Take a polar flight to Grimsey Island and stand in the Arctic Circle. Visit Snæfellsjokull National Park in Grundarfjordur — full of glaciers, lava fields, calderas and basalt cliffs. Cruise Prince Christian Sound, a fjord system connecting the Labrador and Irminger Seas. In Greenland, soak in Uunartoq's 100-degree hot springs, see polar bears in Nanortalik, sail Tasermiut Fjord and hike the trails out of Narsaq. Wrap up your voyage in Boston, where you can walk the Freedom Trail, grab a lobster roll in the North End, and toast the journey's end at a historic harborside pub.

items.title: Star Collector: Seaside Sophistication of Spain & the French & Italian Rivierias
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Bordeaux on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in Portofino’s Ligurian Sea dishes like pasta with mussels and seafood risotto. Soak in the sights and wines of Bordeaux. Explore the Guggenheim Museum. Venture to the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela. Head to Porto to stroll the cobblestone streets filled with colorful buildings of Ribeira and scenic riverbanks. Ride the famous trams of Lisbon, awash in "blue azulejos". Spend a night in Seville, the birthplace of flamenco, sampling tapas, gazpacho and fried fish. Add spice to your trip in Tangier savoring Moroccan fare like couscous, tagine and mint tea. Cook paella in Malaga or take a trip to the Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba.  Witness the beaches of Sanary-sur-Mer and the Côte d'Azur in Cannes. Pass Portofino’s charming piazzetta as you hike the cliffs to the seaside village of Santa Margherita Ligure, passing vineyards, olive groves and medieval dwellings along the way.

items.title: Postcards from Northern Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: From the remote ancient monasteries to the warm waters of little-known beaches, this Greece cruise of Roman forums, royal tombs, and rustic countryside cuisine explores northern Greece and western Turkey. Spend an exclusive evening savoring a dinner on Harbor Street outside Ephesus. Wander between the broken columns of Philippi outside Kavala and explore the ancient forum, theater, and basilicas. Lose yourself in Thessaloniki's royal tombs, Byzantine fortifications, and early gold jewelry prior to an evening of grilled meats and regional wines during an overnight port stay. Witness the contrasts of sweeping summit views and cloistered monastic life inside Medieval monasteries perched atop Meteora's formidable rock formations. Seek out the thematic backdrops on Skopelos, or escape inland on a forested hiking tour of forgotten flagstone roads and trickling natural springs.

items.title: Star Collector: Eternal Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Istanbul on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark through Greece and Turkey, exploring less visited ports and experiencing the beauty of the Greek Isles. Sail to Kusadasi, home of the ancient Greek city of Ephesus. Continue through the Aegean Sea to Kavala, known for beaches, local cuisine, and historic sites. In Thessaloniki, explore the city’s landmarks or visit the Museum of the Royal Tombs, a UNESCO site. In Volos, take an excursion to the Meteora Byzantine Monasteries. On Skopelos, see filming sites from "Mamma Mia!" before heading to the Corinth Canal and Delphi. Visit Santorini's Oia for its iconic, white-washed buildings with blue domes. In Bodrum, explore the Castle, the ancient Mausoleum of Halicarnassus, and the Museum of Underwater Archaeology. Conclude your journey at the Greek islands of Mykonos and Lemnos, then end in Istanbul with tours of the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, or a guided food tour through the markets.

items.title: Star Collector: Mysteries & Masterpieces of Japan & South Korea
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Tokyo on Star Seeker
items.tourMetaDescription: Step aboard Star Seeker for a one-of-a-kind adventure that combines the thrill of the unknown with the joy of discovery. Your voyage begins in northern Japan with 10 days of mystery, each port revealed just 36 hours before arrival. Will it be a fishing village tucked along rugged coastlines, a hidden cultural gem, or a new-to-Windstar harbor? After this intiail intrigue, the curtain rises to reveal an unforgettable lineup of destinations: Osaka, Takamatsu, Hiroshima, Nagasaki and more — plus scenic cruising through the Seto Inland Sea and past haunting Hashima Island. You’ll even cross into South Korea for a stop in Busan.

items.title: Star Collector: Pacific Horizons & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker
items.tourMetaDescription: Let Windstar be your guide on a journey that blends the anticipation of crossing the Pacific with the ports kept secret. During your days at sea, take time to explore Star Seeker, our newest yacht, and enjoy the unique opportunities onboard — from wellness treatments at the World Spa by Windstar to gourmet dining options with dishes created by James Beard Foundation award winning chefs. Guests are invited to visit the Open Bridge, where you can engage with officers and learn about navigation firsthand. Once you arrive in Japan, the mystery begins: ten ports revealed only 36 hours in advance, some completely new to Windstar. The adventure concludes in vibrant Osaka, a city alive with food culture, history, and easy access to Kyoto’s temples and gardens.

items.title: Greenland: North Atlantic Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Boston, Ma on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Float past turquoise-tinged ice floes as you experience Greenland’s remote southern fjords and villages prior to visiting the scenic coasts of Newfoundland, Nova Scotia and New England during this voyage along the North Atlantic’s most pristine and picturesque shorelines. Survey towering icebergs and catch glimpses of fin, killer, and pilot whale pods, along with native seabirds like fulmars, great cormorants and black-legged kittiwakes during your Denmark Strait crossing and subsequent sailing past glacier-etched outcroppings throughout Prince Christian Sound. Embark on an iceberg safari beyond Narsaq. Drift close to towering, picture-perfect ice blocks and calving glaciers in Sermilik Fjord. Sample smoky onion soup, duck filets drenched in wild berry sauce and other authentic French cuisine.

items.title: Star Collector: Greenland Fjords, Canadian Maritimes
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Montreal, Qc on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Venture into the lesser-known coastlines and communities of Greenland, Canada and New England during this remarkable voyage crossing the North Atlantic. Admire fractured glaciers, ivory ice fields and drifting ice floes on a day of scenic sailing in Greenland’s remote Prince Christian Sound. Sample grilled wolf fish, dried salted cod and tender musk ox meat amid stacked crab pots, fish-drying racks and brightly painted houses in Qaqortoq, Nanortalik and Narsaq in Greenland. Wander the grounds of a 1,000-year-old Norse settlement near St. Anthony, and tour sod buildings identical to those that sheltered early settlers from harsh Newfoundland winters centuries ago. Walk among weathered French and British artillery artifacts at National Battlefields Park, or sip your way through Quebec City’s outstanding microbreweries on a delicious walking tour in a thriving downtown community.

items.title: Star Collector: Wonders of Andalusia, Provence & Tuscany
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Lisbon on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise the Iberian coast from Lisbon to the Moorish marvels of Andalusia and Morocco, then explore the scenic perfection and rich culture along Spain’s Costa del Sol, France’s Cote d’Azur, and Italy’s Ligurian Riviera . See all of this region’s must-sees: Lisbon’s Pina Palace, Seville’s Alcazar, Malaga’s Alhambra, Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia, and Rome’s... everything. Surround yourself in scenic beauty from Morocco’s exotic Blue City to Italy’s Cinque Terre. And enjoy unique small-ship experiences from cruising up the Guadalquivir River to an overnight in Seville, to playing in riviera waters off the Watersports Platform. With several overnights and late evening departures, you can enjoy a flamenco performance and tapas in Seville, learn to make paella in Valencia, watch the lights come on in Monte Carlo, and more.

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Nights & Adriatic Delights
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Venice on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Lisbon to Rovinj on an extraordinary journey where boutique ports and storied cities reveal the heart of the Mediterranean. Overnight stays in Lisbon and Seville provide time to savor their vibrant culture, cuisine, and nightlife. Along Spain’s coast, discover Marbella’s chic Puerto Banús, Cartagena’s Roman history, and Valencia’s lively blend of tradition and innovation. The French Riviera unfolds through smaller gems like Port-Vendres and Sanary-sur-Mer, balanced by the glitz of Monte Carlo and Cannes. Continue to Italy’s Portofino and Portoferraio before sailing into the Adriatic for Kotor’s fjord-like beauty and Croatia’s medieval treasures in Dubrovnik, Split, and Rovinj.

items.title: 2027 Japan Mystery Cruise
items.journeyText: Journey from Sapporo / Otaru, Hokkaido to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the thrill of the unknown on a Mystery Cruise aboard our newest yacht, 224-guest Star Seeker, beginning in Hokkaido, Japan’s wild northern frontier. Each destination will be revealed just 36 hours before arrival, giving you the chance to uncover hidden gems across Japan and South Korea, including less-visited ports brand-new to Windstar. Your adventure concludes in vibrant Osaka, the gateway to Kyoto, after days of surprise, discovery, and unforgettable moments. A journey with Windstar isn’t just about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with. When you cruise with us, you become part of the Windstar family, embraced with warm hospitality and thoughtful service at every turn, ensuring that every mystery feels like coming home. Don’t miss this one-of-a-kind adventure!

items.title: Star Collector: Italian Trio
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the culture, history and cuisine on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 15-day cruise of the Adriatic, Ionian, Ligurian and Tyrrhenian seas. This back-to-back cruise is ideal for optimizing shore excursion time in Italy, Croatia, Montenegro, Monaco, France and Spain. Stroll through Roman ruins in Rovinj, Croatia, sample olives and smoked hams at a centuries-old family farm in Montenegro, or savor an unforgettably romantic evening dinner at Château Eza in Èze 1,400 feet above the beaches of the French Riviera.

items.title: Southeast Canadian Explorations
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to Boston, Ma on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Quebec’s French-flavored history, the fusion of Acadian and Scottish cultures in Nova Scotia — each province distills its own blend of Old World and New, bucolic and urbane. Overnight in Quebec City and browse the shops and boulangeries along picturesque Petit Champlain, the oldest street in North America. Take in the brilliance of New England’s fall colors and the historic sites of Boston, one of America’s oldest cities.

items.title: Star Collector: Autumn in Newfoundland and New England
items.journeyText: Journey from Boston, Ma to Montreal, Qc on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Autumn leaves, scenic lighthouses, French culture, Colonial history… discover it all as you cruise between the scenic St. Lawrence River and Gulf, and Boston. Fall in love with Gallic culture and Old World streets lined with bistros, boutiques, and boulangeries, and spend your old Euros in St. Pierre & Miquelon, the last remaining French territories in North America. Take in the epic scenery of vibrant maples, lonely lighthouses, storybook fishing villages, and natural wonders in St. Anthony and Bonne Bay, a yacht-exclusive port. Soak up history as you walk the cobblestone streets of Old Quebec, Boston’s Freedom Trail, and the Fortress of Louisbourg. And add to your UNESCO life list as you tick off nearly half a dozen ranging from America’s first Viking outpost to unspeakably beautiful Gros Morne National Park.

items.title: Quebec and Newfoundland Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to Montreal, Qc on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey through Eastern Canada’s most compelling UNESCO World Heritage Sites and remote coastal regions on a voyage defined by dramatic landscapes, fall colors, maritime history, and meaningful cultural discovery. Sail deep into the Saguenay Fjord — the only navigable fjord in eastern North America — where towering cliffs, waterfalls, fall foliage, and wildlife-rich waters are best experienced from the deck of a small ship. Explore museum-rich ports and historic communities throughout Quebec, Newfoundland, and Labrador, from the marine and naturalist traditions of Tadoussac to the archaeological significance of Red Bay’s UNESCO-listed Basque Whaling Station. Discover the wild beauty of Gros Morne National Park at Bonne Bay, experience whale watching in St. Anthony, encounter the limestone monoliths of the Mingan Archipelago in Havre St. Pierre, and experience the rare French heritage of St. Pierre & Miquelon. An overnight stay in St. John’s allows time to immerse yourself in one of North America’s great seafaring cities, including visits to Signal Hill and The Rooms, one of the world’s most authentic maritime museums. The voyage concludes in Montreal, a UNESCO City of Design, where centuries of French heritage, architecture, and culture provide a fitting finale to an unforgettable autumn journey.

items.title: Star Collector: Fall Leaves & Caribbean Breezes
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark in Montreal, City of a Hundred Steeples, and overnight in Quebec City, with its UNESCO World Heritage Old Town, to find 400-year-old ramparts filled with history. Enjoy the breathtaking seascapes of Gaspé, waves crashing against limestone cliffs, and watch sugar maples and birch trees flout their fall colors. Retrace the battles for North America in the Fortress of Louisbourg, the UNESCO town of Lunenburg, the Citadel in Halifax, and Boston — where the Freedom Trail leads you to Paul Revere’s house. Then, trade in your autumn palette for Bermuda’s spring colors — blushing pink beaches and turquoise waters. Wander historic forts and UNESCO sites in Bermuda, St. Kitts and San Juan before sailing on to chic St. Bart. Granite boulders form The Baths on Virgin Gorda, perfect for a soak or snorkel. Colorful Old San Juan will keep you busy as you await your flight home.

items.title: Star Collector: Bermuda & Caribbean Island Explorer
items.journeyText: Journey from Boston, Ma to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from the North Atlantic into the heart of the Caribbean on an extended journey shaped by island character and days unrushed at sea. Take advantage of rare overnights in Bermuda’s historic towns before continuing toward San Juan’s timeless fortresses and colorful shoreline. You’ll also have two full days to experience Gustavia and Virgin Gorda, giving you more time to enjoy their beaches, cafés, and sheltered bays. From there, explore quiet anchorages in the Virgin Islands, snorkel pristine bays, and wander small-ship harbors like Jost Van Dyke and Virgin Gorda.

items.title: Star Collector: Arc of Iberia, Morocco & the Canary Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Tarragona (Barcelona) to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel through Iberian cities, Moroccan cultural capitals, and Atlantic island shores on a richly layered route designed for deeper exploration. Two nights in Málaga bring ample time for museum-hopping, mountain village visits, and unhurried evenings along the waterfront. Dual calls in Tangier allow you to pair kasbah explorations with modern coastal neighborhoods. An overnight in Marrakesh reveals medina alleyways, artisan workshops, and traditional Berber flavors. Continue south to Agadir’s seaside markets before sailing to the Canary Islands, where volcanic peaks, golden beaches, and temperate breezes deliver a final shift in scenery and pace.

items.title: Star Collector: Spain, Morocco & Atlantic Archipelagos
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Barcelona on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel through southern Spain, Morocco, Madeira, and the Canary Islands on a route designed for extended exploration. Overnights in Marrakesh, and Funchal add meaningful time for galleries, souks, gardens, wineries, and evening exploration. With two visits to Santa Cruz de Tenerife, you can see the location from multiple angles. The voyage continues through Cádiz, Agadir, Lanzarote, Porto Santo, La Palma, and El Hierro—where volcanic trails, dark-sky viewpoints, and small-ship harbors create distinct experiences only a small ship can offer.

stops.port: El Hierro / Puerto De La Estaca

items.title: Star Collector: Sicilian & Riviera Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail through a journey steeped in history, art, and coastal charm as you travel from Rome to Barcelona. Cruise past fiery Stromboli and through the legendary Straits of Messina before exploring Sicily’s vibrant cities and ancient ruins. Discover the beauty of Malta’s golden capital, Valletta, and stroll the timeless streets of Sorrento and the Florence gateway of Livorno.

items.title: Moroccan Magic, Spanish Sizzle
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Malaga on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge your senses in remote natural settings, intricate Islamic art, exotic aromatic spices, and delicious culinary treasures throughout Morocco, southern Spain and the Canary Islands during this voyage to northwest Africa and southwest Europe. Glide through lucent Canary Island waters in a double kayak beyond the warm sandy shores of Las Canteras beach at Las Palmas. Stir up a savory and authentic Moroccan meal as you learn firsthand about Berber culture over a delicious cooking class in the foothills of the Atlas Mountains. Linger late in Merrakech souks browsing colorful scarves, tagine pottery and argan oils, or dine on Sambousek, cheese filled pastries, during an overnight stay in Casablanca. Tap your toes to a stirring Flamenco performance over Spanish red wines in Cadiz.

items.title: Star Collector: Morocco, Madeira & the Canary Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Malaga on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel from Iberia’s southern shores to Morocco’s medinas and onward to Atlantic islands seldom reached on a single itinerary. An overnight stay in Málaga provide time for Andalusian art and villages, followed by Tangier’s kasbah lanes and another overnight in Marrakesh for souks, gardens, and Berber flavors. Cross to Madeira for an overnight in Funchal, where levada walks, wine tastings, and hillside viewpoints reveal another side of the Atlantic world. Continue to Porto Santo, La Palma, and El Hierro—each offering landscapes that range from volcanic vineyards to forested trails. This extended voyage rewards travelers who value immersive days ashore.

stops.port: El Hierro / Puerto De La Estaca

items.title: Star Collector: Hearty Ports & Rum Punches - A Transatlantic Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Philipsburg, St. Maarten on Wind Surf
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise from Portugal across the Atlantic to white Caribbean beaches, vibrant tropical fish and savory West Indies cuisine during this 19-day transatlantic crossing. Relax, unwind and refocus with back-to-back spa days throughout your ocean crossing and dine on award-winning meals. Relive history while sailing aboard a former America's Cup competition sailboat or cook up delicious French meals with a certified chef in Philipsburg, St. Maarten. Roll out in offroad vehicles for an unrushed day of snorkeling on Tortola's secluded beaches. Swim and frolic with dolphins near Jost Van Dyke in the British Virgin Islands. Snorkel above colorful coral and dizzying schools of curious fish on Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands. Glide over a sunken ship in a semi-submersible and take in a glowing Caribbean sunset during a catamaran cruise off Gustavia's tropical beaches on St. Barts.

items.title: Hidden Gems of the Canary Islands & Madeira
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Columbus slept here, Winston Churchill painted here, and Agatha Christie wrote here, but you don’t have to be famous to fall in love with this place. This volcanic archipelago off the coast of Africa can and does charm everyone who visits, although it’s not the same charm for all. Some admire the diversity and drama of the landscapes, a tapestry of smooth and rough, black and green, blue and gold. Others are wooed by quaint colonial towns built a century before Columbus sailed, their cobbled streets lined by dry-stone homes with hand-carved wooden balconies. Sip a glass of sweet and citrusy poncha. Ride wicker toboggans, camels and classic cars. Breathe in air scented with orange, oleander and eucalyptus. And gaze at stars so numerous and bright they seem to put galaxies within reach.

stops.port: El Hierro / Puerto De La Estaca

items.title: Tahitian Treasures & Magnificent Marquesas Air + Hotel Package from LAX
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Go beyond a typical Tahiti cruise during this island odyssey throughout French Polynesia and the remote Marquesas Islands. Enjoy a stay at the elegant Intercontinental near the city center before your waiting yacht takes you to the most serene destinations in French Polynesia and the Marquesas. Follow in the creative footsteps of Symbolist artist Paul Gauguin as you tour his home on Hiva Oa, then feel the hand-hewn surfaces of the largest Tiki sculptures in the Pacific. Journey to Fakarava’s lagoon, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve teeming with life. Admire colorful coral from your glass-bottom boat near Tiputa on Rangiroa. Swim with sea life in Bora Bora’s Blue Lagoon prior to a romantic starlit overnight port stay. Trek along Moorea’s rolling Opunohu Valley trail on your way to majestic views of Mount Mouaroa, Mount Rotu and Mount Tohiea — three of the highest summits in the Society Islands.

items.title: Star Collector: Grand South Pacific Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Singapore on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey across 26 different ports and some of the Pacific’s most compelling island groups, with overnights in Bora Bora, Papeete, Fiji and Bali, plus repeated calls to Moorea for unhurried exploration. Travel from French Polynesia’s biosphere reserves, the Marquesas’ dramatic valleys, and the Cook Islands’ lagoons to Tonga’s royal landmarks and Fiji’s volcanic highlands. Continue into Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea, where waterfalls, traditional cooking, and marine biodiversity reveal the region’s depth. Crossing into East Timor and Indonesia brings striking contrasts, including Komodo’s rugged terrain and Bali’s cultural traditions. Ample sea days—including a short 3-night crossing of Java Sea—providing restorative space to read, work on passion projects, recharge, or simply enjoy open-ocean quiet.

items.title: Star Collector: Polynesian Paradise & Fijian Shores
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Lautoka, Viti Levu on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: This far-reaching South Pacific exploration reveals islands few travelers experience in a single voyage— remote Marquesan valleys filled with towering tikis, Fakarava’s protected Tuamotu reefs, Rangiroa’s deep-blue channels, and the radiant lagoons of Aitutaki and Rarotonga in the Cook Islands. Continue to Tonga’s sea-carved caverns and Fiji’s rainforest waterfalls and cocoa farms. Added overnights in Bora Bora and Lautoka invite you to linger on warm beaches, savor Polynesian flavors, and enjoy unhurried time that encourages lingering sunsets, slow strolls, and easy island rhythms.

items.title: Star Collector: Journey of the South Pacific Seafarer
items.journeyText: Journey from Benoa (Denpasar), Bali to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: This far-reaching South Pacific journey links French Polynesia’s reefs and volcanic peaks with cultures and coastlines stretching deep into Indonesia. Start among the Tuamotus, the Marquesas, and the Society Islands before moving on to Aitutaki’s lagoon, Tonga’s shoreline, and Fiji’s national parks. Continue through Vanuatu’s Melanian Cultures and onward to the Solomon Islands and Papua New Guinea, where WWII history and local traditions provide meaningful context. A call in East Timor offers coastal viewpoints and Portuguese-influenced heritage, while Komodo provides a rare chance to see the island’s famed dragons. The voyage concludes in Bali, ideal for spending extra time here to explore both its famed resorts and temples such as Uluwatu.

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Islands & Colombian Coast Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Colon on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Trace a route shaped by early explorers, coastal trade routes, and the natural beauty of the southern Caribbean. Visit San Juan, Santo Domingo, Cartagena, and Santa Marta—four of the New World’s oldest cities—then snorkel Isla Catalina’s well-known reef and the coral gardens of Les Saintes. An overnight in Cartagena lets you explore its walled quarters after the day-trippers leave. Farther south, rainforest hikes, calm anchorages, and island communities like Bequia and Les Saintes offer a more relaxed rhythm. Together, the journey brings historical context and Windstar-style access to a wide sweep of the Caribbean.

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands, Spanish Cities & Costa Rica
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin among the Windward Islands, sailing into St. George’s, Bequia, Mayreau, and Les Saintes, where coral-rich waters, quiet anchorages, and easygoing beaches set the tone for the opening days of your journey. Continue on toward Isla Catalina, Santo Domingo, and an overnight in Cartagena, exploring colonial plazas, sea-worn fortifications, and offshore islands known for excellent snorkeling and diving. From the San Blas Islands to Colón, the route carries you through remote stretches of coastline before your daylight transit of the Panama Canal offers a rare, close-up perspective. The voyage concludes along Costa Rica’s Pacific shore, with time in Isla Parida, Golfito, Puerto Jiménez, and Quepos—places where rainforest trails, calm bays, and abundant wildlife reward unhurried exploration.

items.title: Star Collector: Coffee, Canal & Callaloo: Central America, Columbia & the Caribbean
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine Central America’s majestic natural scenery with Caribbean small-port charms during this 2-week cruise through Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico. Learn the ecological importance of cloud forests from an engaging naturalist as you search leafy rainforest canopies for sleepy sloths, rare birds and skittering primates. Dive, swim and hike among the refreshing tropical splendors of Windstar’s Signature Beach Party on Panama’s Isla Parida archipelago. Discover the engineering challenges and triumphs during a narrated daylight transit of the Panama Canal. Sink your teeth in doughy, cheese-stuffed Arepas paired with rich, fresh-roasted artisan coffees at a Colombian café. Wander the length of El Morro’s fortress walls in San Juan, Puerto Rico, a former sanctuary for New World seafarers and daring smugglers aligned with the Spanish Empire.

items.title: The Spanish Main: Rise of the New World
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Colon on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: History buffs, beach bums, and xenophiles will all find something to celebrate on this unique itinerary to Central America and the Caribbean. Discover the barely inhabited tropical islands and private gleaming white-sand beaches. Step back in time to the days of the Spanish Empire as you visit four of the oldest cities in the Americas. Explore forts pockmarked by time and cannon balls. Encounter pirate lore as you dive the wreck of Captain Kidd’s ship off Isla Catalina. And relive it all over mofongo and rum in Old San Juan.

items.title: Star Collector: Legacy of Pacific Wayfinders
items.journeyText: Journey from Singapore to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Traverse an extensive arc of the Pacific and Southeast Asia, connecting French Polynesia, the Cook Islands, Tonga, Fiji, Melanesia, Indonesia and Singapore. Along the way, explore lagoon-rich islands such as Moorea, Bora Bora and the Cook Islands; discover the cultural depth of Tonga and Fiji; and experience the dramatic coastlines and community traditions found throughout Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea, including Champagne Bay and the Conflict Islands.  Farther west, encounters in Dili and Komodo reveal the landscapes and wildlife of East Timor and Indonesia, followed by an overnight in Bali to explore its Hindu temples, local artisans, and renowned resort areas.

items.title: Star Collector: Polynesia, Melanesia & Indonesia Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from Benoa (Denpasar), Bali to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail through French Polynesia to and the volcanic archipelagos of Melanesia and Indonesia. Lagoon-rich islands like Moorea, Bora Bora, Aitutaki, and Rarotonga offer reef exploration, mountain scenery, and Polynesian cultural traditions. Fiji adds rainforest waterfalls on Taveuni, geothermal activity in Savusavu, and quiet village beaches in the Yasawa Islands. Farther west, Vanuatu’s waterfalls and Champagne Bay’s clear shallows meet the WWII history of Guadalcanal and the coastal traditions of Papua New Guinea, including the pristine reefs of the Conflict Islands. Dili introduces Portuguese-influenced architecture, while Indonesia combines Komodo’s wildlife with Bali’s temples and dynamic food culture.

items.title: Star Collector: Atlantic Crossing to the Virgin Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Cadiz to San Juan on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: This extended Atlantic-to-Caribbean sailing follows a rare winter route that links Europe, the open ocean, and the islands of the eastern Caribbean in one continuous journey, with experiences shaped by both destination and time at sea. Begin in Lisbon with its historic neighborhoods and riverfront cafés, then pause in Madeira for botanical gardens, coastal walks, and views from Monte. A true transoceanic crossing follows, offering days to settle into shipboard life before landfall in the Caribbean. Once there, small-ship access opens the door to snorkeling off Jost Van Dyke, beach time at Virgin Gorda’s Prickly Pear, exploring colonial streets in San Juan, and dining ashore in Gustavia after sunset. Cruz Bay and Basseterre invite hiking, sailing, and easy island exploration, creating a journey defined by variety, distance, and unhurried discovery.

items.title: Unspoiled Secrets of the South Pacific
items.journeyText: Journey from Lautoka, Viti Levu to Benoa (Denpasar), Bali on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Immerse yourself in relaxing solitude and remote Pacific Island cultures on this 20-night voyage to lesser-known South Pacific tropical havens. Wander authentic Fijian villages and uncrowded white-sand beaches on Yasawa I Rara Island, a reclusive setting only opened to tourism in the 1980s. Discover why travelers adore Vanuatu, where near Port Vila you can savor tropical fruits, swim in refreshing waterfalls, and experience the warm hospitality and vibrant traditions of this 80-island nation. In the Solomon Islands, learn somber details of Guadalcanal and fierce World War II engagements at museums and memorials in Honiara. Dish up taro, sago puddings, and Papua New Guinea specialties during a clay-pot cooking class near Alotau’s beaches. Watch lumbering Komodo dragons stalk the rocky shorelines of Komodo National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Enjoy an overnight stay in Benoa, Bali, where you can dine on delicious shellfish along scenic southern beaches and enjoy unhurried time to explore the island’s rich cultural heritage.

items.title: Star Collector: Treasures of the South Pacific
items.journeyText: Journey from Singapore to Lautoka, Viti Levu on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Immerse yourself in the rhythms and cultures of the South Pacific as you explore Fiji’s outer islands, Vanuatu’s lush interiors, the Solomon Islands’ historic shores, and the quiet lagoons of Papua New Guinea. Meet local communities, sample regional dishes, and step into landscapes shaped by volcanic forces and thriving marine life. Journey through Indonesia for encounters with Komodo’s distinctive wildlife and an overnight stay in Benoa, Bali. During your short 3-night crossing through the Java Sea, settle into shipboard life—an ideal stretch for a passion project, restorative spa time, or simply watching the horizon widen.

items.title: Winter in Croatia & Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Venice on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the Adriatic and Greece from new perspectives during this 8-day cruise that touches on storied landmarks and intimate, little-known ports on the Adriatic Sea and in Greece. Admire Zadar’s Medieval city walls and charming boutiques. Learn about the global success of Croatian organic vineyards as you sample wines in a farming village. Take in Dubrovnik’s Old Town charms from the heights of a cable car. Savor local smoked hams, sausages and homemade cheeses on a Montenegro olive farm tour outside Kotor. Transit the tapered, sheer-walled Corinth Canal, a time-saving dream of the rulers of antiquity. This Adriatic-to-Greece odyssey ends in Athens, among the shadows of the Parthenon, silent monuments to ancient athletic competitions and the savory aroma of souvlaki, seasoned and skewered grilled meats wrapped in pita bread and sold in countless cafés and sidewalk restaurants.

items.title: Star Collector: Costa Rica, Panama & Aruba
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience a route that links Costa Rica’s national parks and quiet bays with Panama’s tropical islands. Spot squirrel monkeys in Manuel Antonio, zipline above the canopy in Playas del Coco, and explore coastal villages where local markets and wildlife refuges sit just steps apart. Continue to the San Blas Islands for reef snorkeling and time with the Kuna people before a full Panama Canal transit narrated by a canal expert. Arrive in Cartagena for an overnight that lets you explore its walled district after hours before continuing north to the ABC Islands, where time in Willemstad, Curaçao features pastel Dutch colonial architecture, floating markets, and calm coves ideal for swimming. Your journey continues to St. Barts, known for its bright turquoise bays and relaxed French-Caribbean ambiance, followed by visits to Jost Van Dyke and Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands, where white-sand beaches and iconic granite boulders offer some of the most picturesque settings in the Caribbean.

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Charms to Iberian Shores
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Lisbon on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: This voyage moves between distinctive Caribbean favorites—San Juan, St. George’s, Bequia, Mayreau, Les Saintes, and Marigot—and the expansive quiet of an ocean crossing to Lisbon, Portugal. Stops in Agadir and Casablanca add a North African layer to the journey, with Casablanca offering access to Marrakesh’s souks, gardens, and Moorish architecture. While port days deliver classic West Indies appeal, time at sea becomes an opportunity: pick up a shelved creative project, relax in the spa, or join officers on the open bridge to learn how they chart the course. A journey designed for travelers who appreciate both exploration and space to recharge.

items.title: Star Collector: A Winter Muse in the Mediterranean
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Venice on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise through Greece, Italy and Croatia, with three overnight stays plus a passage through the Corinth Canal –  a small ship exclusive. See famous Greek cities like Athens and Corfu, and discover new places like maiden port Preveza, a charming town with pedestrian-only streets. Explore Italy and Sicily with their fabulous food, wine and culture – with major players like Rome, Naples, and overnights in Venice, Catania and Crotone, a small town with a surprisingly rich and colorful history. Walk Dubrovnik’s storybook Old Town and get to the heart of Croatian culture with visits to village homes and cottage industries, cooking classes, olive oil tastings and more. Whether you’re learning to cook Neapolitan pizza in the shadow of Mt. Vesuvius or discovering the lost art of silk production in Dubrovnik, you’ll experience the most intimate and authentic version of the Mediterranean.

items.title: Star Collector: Grand Mediterranean
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Venice on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience 53 nights tracing an unbroken arc from the Canary Islands to Venice across seven countries and 33 unique ports. It opens in the Atlantic with Madeira and the lesser-known Canary Islands of La Palma, El Hierro, and La Gomera before crossing to Morocco, with overnights in Casablanca for Marrakesh and Tangier. Spain unfolds over two weeks: Cádiz and Seville, three nights in Málaga with Granada within reach, then the Mediterranean coast through Barcelona. The French Riviera and Ligurian coast lead into Tuscany, Rome, Naples, and Sicily before the Adriatic delivers Dubrovnik, Zadar, Venice, Trieste, Opatija, and Piran in Slovenia. Overnights and late-night departures throughout give time to explore rather than simply arrive.

items.title: Star Collector: Panama, Aruba & the British Virgin Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Fuerte Amador, Panama City to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin along the southern Caribbean coast, where time in Cartagena reveals centuries of fortifications and plazas, and the San Blas Islands introduce clear shallows, local communities, and a chance to enjoy the Marina. Bocas del Toro adds wildlife-rich mangrove channels before your daylight Panama Canal transit offers an up-close look at locks, lakes, and the workings of this crucial passage. From Panama, the journey shifts toward the islands off South America and the northern Caribbean. Explore Aruba’s Dutch-Caribbean architecture, Curaçao’s backcountry tracks, and Bonaire’s protected reefs. Continue to Gustavia, Jost Van Dyke, and Virgin Gorda for beaches, snorkeling, and classic small-ship anchorages before concluding in San Juan.

items.title: Winter in Italy and the Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover a different side of the Mediterranean, with this itinerary that offers a perfect combination of small towns and large, major attractions and new discoveries. Learn to cook authentic Croatian dishes or have a favorite vintage at a Sicilian winery. Discover gems like Preveza and Crotone  – small towns that give you access to a unique Vlatch culture and one of the most beautiful medieval villages in Italy . From Crotone, discover Castello Aragonese located in nearby Le Castella or Santa Severina, one of the most beautiful ancient villages in Italy.  Preveza serves as the gateway to multiple archaeological sites, including the ancient city of Nikopolis. Transit the narrow Corinth Canal to Itea and visit the UNESCO site of Delphi.  Take your time and explore the Acropolis, Pompeii, the Sistine Chapel and Corfu’s Old Town. Spend the night in Catania with a view of Mt. Etna.

items.title: Island Trails: Aruba to the Virgin Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover natural wonders along northern and southern Caribbean beaches during this seven night voyage ranging from islands off South America to Puerto Rico. Roll into Curacao's lush wilds on a 4x4 tour seeking sunning lizards and pink flamingos. Snorkel between coral reefs and undulating sea grass at Bonaire Marine Park, a 6,700-acre sanctuary rich in tarpon, parrotfish, reef perch, and several sea turtle species. Sip sparkling wine or your preferred beverage during a romantic sunset sailing beyond the twinkling lights of Gustavia Harbor's nightlife. Swim and play with friendly dolphins on balmy Jost Van Dyke. Explore the landmark Baths--massive granite boulders--on the white powdery sands of Virgin Gorda prior to spending the afternoon on this warm beach or in Devil's Bay's clear waters.

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands, ABC Islands & the Virgin Island
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: This extended Caribbean route follows a steady arc from the Windward Islands into the ABC Islands and onward to the British Virgin Islands. Days unfold in Grenada, Bequia, and St. Lucia, where volcanic peaks, protected bays, and easy access to snorkeling and diving shape the rhythm of the voyage. Les Saintes adds remarkable underwater visibility before the itinerary shifts south toward Aruba, Curaçao, and Bonaire for reef exploration and backcountry adventures. Northbound, time in Gustavia, Jost Van Dyke, and Virgin Gorda highlights classic small-ship anchorages and shoreline trails, including the granite formations of the Baths. The journey concludes in San Juan after visiting some of the Caribbean’s most distinctive coastlines and island cultures.

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Collection: ABC, BVI & the Windwards
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to San Juan on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel through three distinct Caribbean regions on a route that offers broad geographic range and access to smaller ports. In the Windwards, sample spices in St. George’s and explore Bequia’s maritime traditions before sailing toward the ABC Islands for protected diving sites and colorful coastal towns. Continue north to Gustavia’s boutiques, Jost Van Dyke’s laid-back coves, and Virgin Gorda’s iconic Baths, where trails weave through giant granite boulders. San Juan’s Old World architecture and dining complete the experience. Throughout the itinerary, contrasting islands—arid ABC reefs, lush Grenadine bays, and BVI anchorages used by private yachts—create a journey rich in local culture, shoreline activities, and opportunities to enjoy the advantages of small-ship travel.

items.title: Star Collector: Arc of Iberia, Morocco & the Canary Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Tour the best of Iberia on this voyage to the Canary Islands and beyond. In Portugal, even large cities feel warm and inviting, historic buildings softened by bougainvillea and sidewalks decorated with tiles. Walk the quays of Portimao where the town’s famous sardines are grilled for passersby, and explore Funchal with its farmers market and wicker sleigh rides. You’ll find natural wonders everywhere in the Canary Islands; UNESCO Biosphere Reserves, Marine Reserves and even Starlight Reserves, and learn why so many artists — Picasso, Miró, Dalí, Gaudí — found inspiration here. Tour the Alhambra, the White Villages and Modernist creations like Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia. Not to mention Costa del Sol shores, tasty tapas and, of course, flamenco. Enjoy intermissions from your Iberian adventures in Casablanca and Gibraltar with time to shop the casbah and visit the Barbary Apes.

items.title: Spanish Symphony & Madrid Medley Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Hop from port-to-port on an extraordinary Spanish Symphony & Madrid Medley cruise itinerary that takes you along the picturesque Andalusian coast and deep into the heart of Spain. Immerse yourself in Almeria’s Moorish heritage, Costa del Sol’s “white villages,” and Mallorca’s stunning beaches, with plenty of time to enjoy Lisbon’s charming cobblestone streets and Barcelona’s bold Gaudi architecture. Traveling by high-speed train, you’ll spend four nights at a five-star hotel in Madrid, immersing yourself in the capital’s vibrant culture. Highlights of this Madrid cruise experience include early entry to the renowned Prado Museum and an exclusive flamenco dinner show at Spain’s only Michelin-starred tablao. You’ll take a daytrip to admire medieval Segovia’s first-century Roman aqueduct and iconic Alcázar Castle, and spend a night in Barcelona, where you’ll be whisked away to a beautiful 450-year-old winery in the Penedés region.

items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Amsterdam on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: This voyage moves between distinctive Caribbean favorites—San Juan, St. George’s, Bequia, Mayreau, Les Saintes, and Marigot—and the expansive quiet of an ocean crossing to Lisbon, Portugal. Calls in Lisbon and Brest, France, introduce European history, coastal culture, and walkable city centers before the journey concludes in Amsterdam. While port days deliver classic West Indies appeal, time at sea becomes an opportunity: pick up a shelved creative project, relax in the spa, or join officers on the open bridge to learn how they chart the course—a journey designed for travelers who appreciate both exploration and space to recharge.

items.title: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Surf
items.tourMetaDescription: The magnificent ports of the Rivieras each have their own distinctive allure. In Madrid, you’ll have four nights to immerse yourself in its vibrant culture. Beat the crowds to the Prado Museum, to revel in Spanish masterpieces. Learn to cook tapas at a boutique cooking school. Enjoy a flamenco show and a three-course Michelin star dinner. Spend a day in Segovia, a medieval city (also UNESCO World Heritage site) featuring an ancient Roman aqueduct that winds around the edge of town. Get a guided tour through the city’s Gothic-style Cathedral, stopping at the iconic Alcázar castle. Indulge in a wine tasting at the Cavas Cordoniu cellars in the wine region of Catalonia, where you’ll learn the art of wine tasting. Your travel between Barcelona and Madrid will be in Comfort Class via high-speed train. Windstar picks up your luggage so it will be waiting for you at your hotel.

items.title: Adriatic Shores & Italian Coasts
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in Venice and trace the Adriatic south through Croatia and Montenegro, calling on ports rich in history and coastal scenery. Explore Rovinj’s old town, walk through Split within the walls of Diocletian’s Palace, and spend time in Dubrovnik’s historic center before sailing into Montenegro’s Bay of Kotor for scenic cruising and access to hilltop views. The route then turns west to Sicily, with Messina serving as a gateway to Taormina and its ancient theater, followed by the Amalfi Coast and an overnight in Sorrento that allows time for Pompeii, Capri, or evening dining ashore. From Italy, the journey continues to Corsica, where Bonifacio’s clifftop citadel overlooks the sea, and on to Sardinia’s Golfo Aranci for swimming and coastal scenery.

items.title: Star Collector: Rome, Corsica & the French Riviera
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer
items.tourMetaDescription: Voyage from Rome to Barcelona through four countries and a string of ports defined by exclusivity and late-night stays. Portovenere, a UNESCO World Heritage site anchored off the Cinque Terre coast, is accessible only by tender. Corsica appears twice: Bastia's Genoese citadel in the north and Bonifacio's clifftop medieval town in the south. Elba follows, with Napoleon's two residences above the harbor, then Portofino, where a late evening at anchor puts the Italian Riviera’s most coveted small-ship village at its most serene. Monte Carlo extends to midnight, Cannes stays until ten, and quieter Sanary-sur-Mer closes the French chapter before Palamós and Barcelona bring the voyage to a close.

items.title: Quick Getaways: Hamburg's Birthday Celebration
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Amsterdam on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: This Quick Getaway is timed around one of the great events in European maritime culture. Sailing the Thames under the Tower Bridge and east into the North Sea, the ship cruises the Elbe inland to Hamburg, arriving in time for the Hafengeburtstag, the world's largest port festival, held each May along the city's 3.5-mile Harbour Mile. More than one million visitors watch over 300 tall ships and historic vessels parade past the Elbphilharmonie and the Landungsbrücken piers, with the Tugboat Ballet and a fireworks display over the Elbe among the highlights. Helgoland follows, Germany's only high-sea island, located far out in the North Sea, car-free and duty-free, with red sandstone cliffs and harbor seals on the beaches. Amsterdam closes out the voyage: canals, the Rijksmuseum, and the merchant houses of the Golden Age.

items.title: Quick Getaways: Amsterdam, Normandy & London
items.journeyText: Journey from Amsterdam to London / Hms Belfast on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: This Quick Getaway links four countries across northern Europe, connecting Amsterdam and London through Belgium and the rivers of Normandy. Bruges, one of the best-preserved medieval cities in Europe, is less than 20 minutes by train from Oostende. Rouen follows, the UNESCO-designated Norman capital where a late-night stay extends time ashore into the evening: Paris by train, Monet's cathedral, and half-timbered streets that have barely changed since the Middle Ages. Honfleur gives access to the D-Day coast and the new Bayeux Tapestry Museum before the Seine gives way to the Thames, sailing beneath Tower Bridge and arriving overnight alongside HMS Belfast, one of London's most central small-ship berths.

items.title: Star Collector: Norway, Germany & the Kiel Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Copenhagen on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Spanning four countries and 16 ports from London to Copenhagen, this voyage traces the full arc of Northern Europe. Departing beneath Tower Bridge, a small ship exclusive, the route calls at eight Norwegian ports across ten days: Egersund and Haugesund, rarely visited by large ships; Art Nouveau Ålesund; the tender-only anchorage at Andalsnes with its Romsdalsfjord scenic cruising; Trondheim's Nidaros Cathedral, coronation church of Norwegian kings; the remote fishing island of Frøya; Olden and the Nordfjord; and Bergen's UNESCO Bryggen Wharf. Hamburg follows with an overnight stay before the Elbe carries the ship to the Kiel Canal, the world's busiest artificial waterway, where unrestricted deck access throughout the 8-hour transit makes this a small-ship exclusive experience. Warnemünde, Binz on Rügen, and Copenhagen close out the voyage.

items.title: Star Collector: The Arc of the Adriatic Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Dubrovnik to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Few voyages pack this much Mediterranean into a single sailing. From Dubrovnik's ancient stone walls to the gilded canals of Venice, from the fjord-like bay of Kotor to the cliffside lemon groves above Sorrento, this 15-night Adriatic journey moves through three countries and some of Europe's most storied coastline at a pace that lets you actually feel each port. Two overnight stays, one in Venice, one in Sorrento, mean full days of unhurried exploration: a morning in Venice's Rialto markets, an afternoon drifting between the Doge's Palace and a hidden “bacaro” (wine bar); or a day on Capri, a morning in Pompeii, and an evening aperitivo back on Sorrento's clifftop terrace. Late-night departures from Dubrovnik, Otranto, and Messina extend your time ashore even further, dinner in the Old Town, a dusk stroll along Otranto's harbor, a late swordfish pasta in Sicily as the lights come on across the Strait. Along the way, Croatia's Dalmatian islands unspool one by one: lavender-scented Hvar, Roman Zadar, the terracotta rooftops of Split, the Venetian-era campanile of Rovinj. Then Montenegro's Kotor, arguably the Adriatic's most dramatic arrival, its medieval walls climbing sheer limestone above a bay that looks more Norwegian fjord than Mediterranean sea.

items.title: Star Collector: Iconic Italy and Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore picturesque ports and ancient ruins during this cruise along Adriatic coastlines, central Mediterranean and the timeless Rivera. Float on the Cetina River, rich in waterfalls, lush forests, with delicious Croatian snacks. Board Zodiac boats in Dubrovnik's Old Town Port and snorkel near the stunning Modra Splja Cave. Cook up Montenegrin lamb and Balkan porridge with a professional Kotor chef. Explore Italy's iconic ports, such as the glamorous Portofino with its luxury yachts, Rome's bustling port of Civitavecchia - the gateway to the Eternal City, Sorrento's charming marina overlooking the Bay of Naples, and Genoa's rich historic maritime heritage, each offering a unique blend of history, beauty, and vibrant coastal culture. Browse Monte Carlo boutiques for one-of-a-kind souvenirs and walk the streets that still host one of the oldest and most famous car races in the world.

items.title: Star Collector: Sicilian Circumnavigation & the Prix du Monde of Monaco
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in the Old World flavors of the Italian coastline prior to partaking in Monaco’s Formula 1 racing during this exploration of Italy and France. Take flight on a helicopter tour above smoldering Mount Etna. Sample uniquely textured dark chocolate bars handcrafted in Modica, a sweet treat blended with nuts, peppers, and vanilla that goes perfectly with smoky espresso. Study skilled Lipari chefs crafting Sicilian pizzas, then roll your own fresh dough for a memorable lunch paired with local red wines and sweet Aeolian cookies. Bicycle to Enfola’s rural roadways and kayak the Elba’s northern coastline. Wander between stacked tires and state-of-the-art race computing technology as you tour Monaco’s F1 Prix du Monde pits on qualifying day, then party through the night prior to watching the complete race the following afternoon!

items.title: Quick Getaway: Germany via the Kiel Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Hamburg to Copenhagen on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: This Quick Getaway is built around one of the great small-ship experiences in northern Europe: a full daylight transit of the Kiel Canal. The 60-mile waterway connecting the North Sea to the Baltic handles more vessel transits than the Panama and Suez Canals combined, and Baltic travelers seek it out specifically on small ships, the only vessels with full deck access for the entire passage[BB1] . An overnight in Hamburg gives a full evening in the Speicherstadt (warehouse district) before the Elbe carries the ship to the canal entrance at Brunsbüttel. Warnemunde follows, with Berlin reachable by train in 2.5 hours, then Binz on Rügen, where the UNESCO-listed Jasmund National Park and the Königsstuhl chalk cliffs are within easy reach.

items.title: Star Collector: Germany & the Baltic States via the Kiel Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Hamburg to Stockholm on Star Pride
items.tourMetaDescription: Few voyages deliver eight countries and five UNESCO World Heritage cities in a single sailing. This voyage opens with the Kiel Canal transit from Hamburg, the world's busiest artificial waterway. From there, it works east across the full sweep of the Baltic. First stops are Copenhagen and the rarely visited island of Bornholm. Next comes UNESCO-listed Gdańsk and the Curonian Spit. Riga follows, with its extraordinary Art Nouveau old town. Medieval Tallinn, the best-preserved city in the Baltic, brings a late-night stay. Helsinki offers a visit to the island fortress of Suomenlinna, also a UNESCO site. Turku features a midnight departure, giving a full evening on the Aura River. Scenic cruising through the Finnish Archipelago Sea leads to Mariehamn in the autonomous Åland Islands, a region that's Swedish-speaking and Finnish-administered. Finally, Stockholm, built across 14 islands, closes out a voyage that has traced the entire rim of the Baltic Sea.

items.title: Star Collector: France, Italy & the Prix du Monde
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription:
Set sail on a Mediterranean voyage anchored by race weekend in Monaco. Dedicated transfers from Nice ensure you arrive at Section K for Saturday's time trials and Sunday's final without any of the logistics. An overnight stay in Nice lets you enjoy the Promenade des Anglais and old town between sessions. Beyond race weekend, the itinerary unfolds along some of the Mediterranean's most storied coastlines.
In Bastia, Corsica's rugged port city sits framed by the Tyrrhenian Sea. Villefranche-sur-Mer offers a pastel-hued fishing village tucked into one of the deepest natural harbors on the Riviera. Cannes brings film-festival glamour and the palm-lined Croisette. Portofino, the jewel-toned Ligurian fishing village, has long been beloved by yachts and celebrities alike. Elba, Napoleon's island of exile, offers quiet coves and hilltop fortresses. Ponza is a volcanic gem with pastel cliffside towns and crystalline waters. The UNESCO-listed Amalfi Coast features cliffside towns like Positano and Amalfi clinging dramatically to the coastline. The Aeolian Islands, a volcanic archipelago north of Sicily, are known for Stromboli's active crater and Lipari's charming harbor. Porto Cervo serves as the glamorous heart of Sardinia's Costa Smeralda.
