items.title: 2028 Mediterranean Mystery Cruise
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Surf
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the thrill of the unknown on a Mystery Cruise aboard Wind Surf. Departing from Athens, gateway to the ancient world, each destination will be revealed just 36 hours before arrival, giving you the chance to uncover hidden gems across the Aegean and Ionian Seas, from cliffside villages that tower ships can't reach to secluded coves known only to locals. Your adventure concludes back in Athens, after 11 nights of surprise, discovery, and unforgettable moments beneath billowing sails. A journey with Windstar isn't just about where you're going — it's about who you're sailing with. When you cruise with us, you become part of the Windstar family, embraced with warm hospitality and thoughtful service at every turn, ensuring that every mystery feels like coming home. Don't miss this one-of-a-kind adventure!

items.title: Star Collector: Italian Charms & Croatian Coastlines
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Star Legend
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey from Southern Italy to the Istrian Coast on this Italian charms & Croatian Coastline cruise. You’ll start in Vibo Valentia to see the beaches of Southern Italy. You can visit the Bronze Statues of Riace Warriors in Reggio Calabria. Next, stop in Taranto to gaze at Greek ruins. In Otranto, you will have a chance to see the historic conical homes in Alberobello. From Puglia, you will detour to the island of Rab in the Northern Dalmatia region of Croatia. Walk through Rovinj’s cobblestone streets up to the St. Euphemia Cathedral. Have an overnight in Dubrovnik. Your Calabrian to Istria pilgrimage continues in Montenegro, as you sail the fjord that leads to Kotor, a UNESCO site. Your final stop is in Piran, Slovenia. Take a tour to Lake Bled and visit Bled Church on an island in the middle of the lake. Your expedition ends in Venice, where you can explore the city at your own pace.

items.title: Star Collector: Adriatic Waters to Italian Shores
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Spanning four countries, 14 ports, and six UNESCO World Heritage sites in 16 nights, this Star Collector voyage traces an arc from Venice to Rome. The Adriatic sets the tone — Rovinj's pastel harbor, Diocletian's Roman palace at Split, Dubrovnik's medieval walls, and the fjord-like bay of Kotor in Montenegro. Messina opens the door to UNESCO-listed Mount Etna and Taormina before two nights in Sorrento deliver full days for Pompeii, Herculaneum, and Capri. From Sorrento, the route continues to Ponza's Roman sea caves, the UNESCO Amalfi Coast, and the Aeolian Islands, where Stromboli erupts at dusk in a spectacle that belongs entirely to small ships. Porto Cervo on Sardinia's Emerald Coast is a small-ship exclusive, and Porto Vecchio in Corsica adds a Genoese citadel and white-sand beaches.

items.title: Star Collector: Corsica, Sardinia & Southern Italy
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: This is the Mediterranean that most travelers never find: three ports in Corsica, an overnight in Sardinia’s only Catalan-speaking city, and a sweep of southern Italy. Three ports in Corsica - Bastia’s Genoese citadel, Ajaccio where Napoleon was born, and Bonifacio on its white limestone cliffs, offer a fuller picture of the island than most dedicated Corsica voyages manage. Alghero follows, its Gothic-Catalan cathedral and sea-facing bastions a legacy of 14th-century Aragonese rule best savored over an overnight stay. The route then turns south through the UNESCO Amalfi Coast, Calabria’s undiscovered ports, two nights in ancient Taranto, and Otranto’s 12th-century cathedral floor mosaic before the Adriatic carries the ship north to dock in Venice’s city center, a small ship exclusive.

items.title: Star Collector:  Marquesas, Tuamotus & Society Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze
items.tourMetaDescription: Go farther into French Polynesia on a voyage that spans the Society Islands, Tuamotus, and the dramatic Marquesas. With extended time in both Fakarava and Rangiroa, explore two of the South Pacific’s most celebrated atolls—drift snorkeling through shark-filled passes in Fakarava’s UNESCO-listed biosphere and navigating Rangiroa’s famed Tiputa Pass with expert guides. In the Marquesas, step ashore in Omoa on Fatu Hiva, where tapa cloth is still crafted by hand, visit the monumental tiki at Lipona Me’ae on Hiva Oa, and explore Nuku Hiva’s storied Taipivai Valley. Throughout the Society Islands, enjoy an overnight in Bora Bora, a private beach celebration on a secluded motu, and time in Moorea’s Cook’s Bay, framed by soaring green peaks.

items.title: Star Collector: Adriatic, Corsica & the Balearics
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Barcelona on Wind Spirit
items.tourMetaDescription: Spanning five countries, 15 ports, and six UNESCO World Heritage sites in 17-nights, this voyage takes the Mediterranean in autumn, when the light softens and the ports belong more to the locals. The route traces the UNESCO triumvirate of Split, Dubrovnik, and Kotor before Otranto and Sorrento, where two nights open the door to Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast in quieter October conditions. From Rome, the voyage calls at Elba, where Napoleon's two residences tell the story of his 300-day exile in 1814, then two Corsican ports: Bastia's Genoese citadel and Calvi, with its 15th-century citadel and a midnight departure to make full use of the evening. The Balearic finale brings Mahon's extraordinary harbor, the largest in the Mediterranean, Georgian gin distilleries marking British occupation, Palma de Mallorca's Gothic cathedral, and finally Barcelona.
